hooks.command: printf '%s\n' 'FACTORY REMINDER: Classify the user prompt above. If it is a NEW FEATURE or BEHAVIOR CHANGE (Android or web), that is anything that adds, removes, or alters user-visible behavior or domain logic, follow the factory harness BEFORE editing any file in app/ or web/: (1) run `bash factory/session_resume.sh`; (2) write or update factory/tasks/task.json with feature, storyId, and acceptanceCriteria; (3) implement; (4) drive `bash factory/gate_retry_loop.sh` until green; (5) append worklog entries via `bash factory/worklog.sh task` and `bash factory/worklog.sh retro`. If the prompt is a bugfix, a refactor with no behavior change, a doc edit, a question, or a harness or config change, this requirement does not apply. When in doubt, ask the user which category applies before editing.'
